s1.syndrome_frame: A chronic cutaneous lesion with crusts and irregular shape, progressing over months
salient_findings: Irregularly shaped 5 × 3 cm plaque with multiple superficial crusts
Eosinophilic keratinocytes with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli infiltrating the reticular dermis
Marked regression of the plaque after treatment, with remaining discrete papular lesions
key_facts: Crusty lesion in the right fronto-orbital region
Excisional biopsy showed lobules and detached aggregates of eosinophilic keratinocytes
Treatment with cemiplimab 350 mg every 3 weeks
Focal area of uptake in the supraorbital lesion on 18F-FDG PET/CT
Marked regression of the plaque after five cycles of treatment

differentials: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands
per_call: Neutrophilic dermatosis of the dorsal hands

shortlist.label: Invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Diagnosed by excisional biopsy and consistent with clinical presentation

shortlist.label: Basal cell carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Dermoscopic evaluation of papules revealed features typical of basal cell carcinoma after treatment

shortlist.label: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ
shortlist.why_kept: Possible precursor to invasive squamous cell carcinoma and consistent with partial metabolic response

shortlist.label: Bowen's disease
shortlist.why_kept: A form of squamous cell carcinoma in situ and could be related to the patient's crusty lesion

shortlist.label: Actinic keratosis
shortlist.why_kept: A potential precursor to squamous cell carcinoma and consistent with the patient's chronic cutaneous lesion

raw.rationale: The excisional biopsy showed lobules and detached aggregates of eosinophilic keratinocytes with pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli infiltrating the reticular dermis, which is consistent with invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Basal cell carcinoma
rejected.why: Although dermoscopic evaluation of papules after treatment revealed features typical of basal cell carcinoma, the initial biopsy and diagnosis were consistent with invasive cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.

rejected.label: Squamous cell carcinoma in situ
rejected.why: The biopsy showed infiltration of the reticular dermis, indicating invasive disease rather than carcinoma in situ.

rejected.label: Bowen's disease
rejected.why: Bowen's disease is a form of squamous cell carcinoma in situ, and the biopsy results indicated invasive disease.

rejected.label: Actinic keratosis
rejected.why: Actinic keratosis is a precursor to squamous cell carcinoma, but the biopsy results showed invasive disease, not just a precursor lesion.
